notes: *an astonishment* is read as part of the rendering of הֲשִׂמֹתִיהוּ, the ASV having taken the form in the sense of desolation; the competing analysis marks it `added` under rule 30. The head stays on *make*, which carries the שׂים lexeme by rule 31's subtraction test.
The assimilated bracketed article of בָּאִישׁ is unrepresented: the phrase's one determiner is *that*, licensed by the written הוּא (rules 12, 41's limit).
The second לְ before מְשָׁלִים is unrepresented, the ASV writing a single *for* (rule 22).
